versions.changelog:
Initial release of behavior-observability skill.

- Provides structured behavior observability for agents/automation pipelines, recording every action (tool/LLM calls, decisions, reviews) as structured events for auditing and analysis.
- Supports multidimensional querying, metric aggregation (error rates, average/p95 latency), and behavior timeline replay for postmortem audit and debugging.
- Integrates with related skills (safety-guardrails, human-in-loop-review, agent-eval-harness, super-agent-loop) by emitting events for a comprehensive, trustworthy behavior log.
- Includes a built-in self-learning module that automatically reviews and improves based on usage, tracking patterns, errors, and user preferences in learned_patterns.json.
- Command line tools provided for emitting events, querying logs, viewing metrics, timeline replay, and managing learning/insight processes.
